Meet 320 Nail Studio

Professional Nails Care & Nails Design

320 Nail Studio

320 Nail Studio is a professional nail salon at 320 W Main St in Lansdale, PA. The studio offers pedicures, manicures, acrylics, dip powder and nail art, plus eyelash lifts, lash extensions and a facial.

Follow the studio on Instagram at @320_nailstudio to see the latest sets and designs.

Walk-ins welcome

Walk-ins welcome, and appointments by phone. No online booking tool, so call ahead or just stop in.
